spans.s: (kṣaudra = Skt. honey, or a kind of honey; here possibly adj., of or made by bees? cf. s.v. kṣudra: kṣaudraṃ madhu Mvy 〔5728〕; Av 〔i.187.7〕; 〔243.1〕; kṣaudramadhu Karmav 〔45.14〕; in all cases immediately foll. by aneḍakam. Also occurs, as in Skt., as subst. without madhu, e.g. Dbh 〔6.8〕; 〔8.11〕; Divy 〔221.11〕; 〔551.27〕.)

kṣaumaka, (adj. or) nt. (= Skt. kṣauma; Pkt. khomaga beside khoma), linen garment: Mvy 〔9161〕 = Tib. zar maḥi ras, acc. to Dict. of French Cath. Miss. cloth made of fibre from nettles (!); Das muslin. See kṣomaka.
